criteria.reason: Current CSS sets the sticky Telegram/mobile .topbar to background: var(--surface), -webkit-backdrop-filter: none, and backdrop-filter: none. Fresh Chromium computed backdrop-filter as none and background-color as opaque rgb(255, 255, 255).

Current request logic defaults broad views to 20 and project-filtered non-CLI views to 100; renderCodexPanel preserves cards.slice(0, 5) for project filters. The fresh 28-test Mini App suite passed its default-limit and project-cap cases.

Current nextDesktopSessionLimit implements 20->50->100->200 with a 200 ceiling, request parsing clamps explicit positive limits to 20..200, and load-more is disabled at 200. Fresh tests passed; fresh Chromium showed the 20->50 and 50->100 links with the expected hrefs.

Current .session-card CSS uses content-visibility: auto and contain-intrinsic-size: auto 180px without changing card markup. Fresh Chromium computed both values, rendered 20 cards, and found three interactive controls plus visible text in the first card.

Fresh reruns passed 28/28 Mini App tests, typecheck, lint, build, and git diff --check. Fresh isolated Chromium smoke on port 3011 verified 20 cards, 872 DOM elements, opaque no-blur topbar, containment styles, visible controls, and the staged load-more link.
